vendor.site.find_note: Ku raadi magaca goobta lagu yaqaan. Waxaa keliya la sheegan karaa meelaha aan horeba u diiwaangelinay inay leeyihiin dayactir, taayir, dhaqid ama qalab.
vendor.site.food_vendor: Sheegashada goob waxay u tahay ganacsiyo joogto ah oo dayactir, taayir iyo dhaqid ah. Liiskaagu waa ku raacaa meel kasta, sidaas darteed halkan wax la sheegto ma jiro.
vendor.site.means.approved: Darawalladu waxay bogga goobtan ku arkaan saacadahaaga, telefoonkaaga iyo adeegyadaada.
vendor.site.means.disputed: Ganacsi kale ayaa isna goobtan sheeganaya. Hawlwadeen ayaa go'aaminaya cidda leh; ilaa markaas midna ma shaqeyso.
vendor.site.means.pending: Hawlwadeen ayaa gacanta ku eega sheegashooyinka. Waxba khariidadda kama beddelmaan intaas ka hor.
vendor.site.means.rejected: Sheegashadan kuma xidhi karin goobta. Soo dir shati ama heshiis kiro oo mar kale sheeg.
vendor.site.mismatch: Magacaasi kuma dhowa magaca aan u hayno goobtan, kaas oo ah:
vendor.site.mismatch_next: Geli magaca goobtu ku shaqeyso, ama dooro goob kale.
vendor.site.no_results: Waxba magacaas kuma habboona. Hubi higgaadda, ama isku day magaca calaamadda ku qoran halkii magaca sharciga ah.
vendor.site.proof_note: Shatiga, biilka adeegga ama heshiiska kirada ayaa hawlwadeenka ka caawiya go'aanka. La'aantood magaca oo keliya ayuu haystaa, sidaas darteed sheegashadu way dheeraan kartaa ama la diidi karaa.
